items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: So I got old man, Professor Delmore, to give me one lesson.

ctx.x: Oh, I see. Yeah. Mm-hmm. And what all different instruments have you played? Did I play? Mm-hmm.

Well, I first started on clarinet. Mm-hmm. Then saxophones began coming out and fellas induced me to try to get a saxophone. But after I got the saxophone, I wanted to be a trumpet, which I wanted to be a trumpet, and then I started playing off-set. Mm-hmm. And then I started on trumpet, and I played trumpet in the band until the Eureka band got without a bass player. Mm-hmm. And they encouraged me to play a few of them. I said, well, I don't know nothing at all about the bass. They said, well, you play the…
It's trumpet and saxophone and clarinet and bass.
